candidates.title: Funerary Papyrus of Tayuhenutmut
candidates.credit: Egyptian; probably Thebes (now Luxor), Egypt / Art Institute of Chicago
candidates.alt_suggestion: Horizontal five-panel document featuring written characters in black on the left four pages and an illustration of the fifth. A seated figure at left in profile, wearing a tall headdress and white clothing, looks toward a dark-haired female figure at right in white with a white object on her head. She holds up her hands in gesture. A panel of hieroglyphs in white squares is visible behind them.
